main_measure.name: slope of next-day return minus coin mean on forecast (pooled, every bar)

statistic.name: OLS slope t, clustered by day

main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms (with the check passing), t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: mean next-day excess return in the top fifth of the forecast > 0

decided_by: the slope's t is 2 or more and the top-fifth mean excess return is above 0.
reading: Regression with intercept over every bar with a next-day return in its window, t from day-clustered (UTC day) standard errors with a G/(G-1) correction; 'bars with a forecast' are bars with a non-zero forecast; the top fifth is bars at or above the pooled 80th percentile of the forecast (non-zero only if that percentile is 0).

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0001439 on the check folds against +0.0003738 on every fold
